data.title: Mobile Developer
data.summary: The role involves developing iOS and Android applications, including digital identity and mobile security features. The work is mostly remote but requires residence in Finland.

requirements.text: At least five years of mobile application development experience
requirements.question: Would someone who has done mobile application development, with fewer than 5 years, be worth a conversation?
requirements.why: The posting makes extensive hands-on mobile application development experience mandatory.

requirements.text: Experience with both iOS and Android development
At least five completed iOS and Android mobile projects
Experience with digital identity, eID, mobile wallets or credentials
Experience implementing mobile device security features

requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires fluent spoken and written Finnish for a role listed with English as a work language.
